lead.headline: Moonbeam Pivots to Base for AI Agent Infrastructure
lead.tldr: The shift of a major Polkadot player to Base signals a broader migration of liquidity and developer focus toward Ethereum L2s to capture the AI agent market.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Moonbeam Pivots From Polkadot to Base to Build AI Agents
top_signals.summary: Moonbeam is pivoting its strategic focus away from Polkadot after four years to migrate to Base, an Ethereum Layer 2. The project aims to build a specialized communication and settlement network specifically for AI agents.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Moonbeam's move suggests that the perceived utility of Polkadot's parachain model is being outweighed by the liquidity and ecosystem velocity of Base.

top_signals.title: Revolut to delist USDT in August, citing regulatory and risk concernsRevolut notified some customers it will delist USDT after Aug. 31, with remaining holdings automatically converted into users’ base currency.
top_signals.summary: Revolut is delisting the stablecoin USDT from its platform effective August 31, citing regulatory and risk concerns. Remaining USDT holdings will be automatically converted into the users' base currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Revolut's delisting of USDT reflects a tightening regulatory environment for stablecoins within European fintech gateways.

top_signals.title: Kraken lets traders use tokenized stocks as collateral for leveraged trades16m
top_signals.summary: Kraken has introduced a feature allowing traders to use tokenized stocks as collateral for leveraged trading. This integration bridges traditional equity markets with crypto-native trading mechanisms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kraken's use of tokenized stocks as collateral accelerates the convergence of TradFi assets and DeFi leverage mechanisms.

top_signals.title: Aave's new Monad market tops $100 million in deposits two days after launch
top_signals.summary: Aave's new market on Monad has rapidly grown, surpassing $100 million in deposits within two days of launch. Additionally, Aave V4 has reached a new all-time high with over $250 million in deposits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $100M inflow into Aave's Monad market in 48 hours demonstrates an immense, untapped appetite for high-performance DeFi primitives.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs log record eighth straight negative week despite large Thursday inflow
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have experienced their eighth consecutive week of negative flows. Despite a large inflow on Thursday, the overall trend remains downward.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Eight straight weeks of negative ETF flows indicate a significant cooling of institutional momentum for Bitcoin as a standalone trade.

on_the_radar.title: US law enforcement group drops opposition to CLARITY Act: Report24m, US law enforcement group drops opposition to CLARITY Act: ReportThe Major County Sheriffs of America said it still wants the CLARITY Act amended to give local law enforcement more resources to investigate illicit finance cases.
on_the_radar.summary: The Major County Sheriffs of America has dropped its opposition to the CLARITY Act. The group continues to advocate for amendments that would provide local law enforcement with more resources to combat illicit finance.

on_the_radar.title: Nearly 1 million wallets are down $3.81 billion on Trump's memecoin: report
on_the_radar.summary: A report indicates that nearly 1 million wallets have suffered combined losses of $3.81 billion on a memecoin associated with Donald Trump. Meanwhile, Trump's financial disclosures reveal significant personal crypto-related income exceeding $1.4 billion for 2025.

on_the_radar.title: Kalshi hits record June trading volume as World Cup fuels prediction markets9m
on_the_radar.summary: Kalshi achieved record trading volumes in June, driven largely by interest in World Cup prediction markets. The surge highlights the growing popularity of event-based trading platforms.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin Realized Profit Loss Ratio Falls to 43-Month Low
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin's realized profit and loss ratio has dropped to its lowest level in 43 months, reaching levels last seen during the FTX collapse. According to CryptoQuant, this extreme decline may indicate that the market has reached or is nearing a bottom.

on_the_radar.title: Tim Draper Denies Moving BTC After Coinbase Transfer Claim
on_the_radar.summary: Tim Draper has denied claims that he moved 1,000 BTC to Coinbase Prime. The denial follows blockchain data analysis by Arkham that suggested a wallet linked to him performed the transfer.

linkedin_post: Moonbeam pivoting from Polkadot to Base after four years is a loud signal about where the actual growth is happening. It is not just a technical migration; it is a strategic admission that the AI agent economy requires the specific liquidity and distribution channels that Base provides. I keep coming back to the fact that while Polkadot offered a vision of a multi-chain future, the market is currently rewarding those who build closer to the center of Ethereum's L2 gravity. Moving to build a settlement network for AI agents on Base is a pragmatic play for distribution over theoretical interoperability. I'd watch if other Polkadot-native projects follow suit, as this could trigger a broader exodus of developers toward the Coinbase-backed ecosystem.
